name: Hospitality Management Upskilling Program
description: Comprehensive training program for experienced hospitality workers to advance to management positions. Covers operations management, customer service excellence, budgeting, and team leadership. 6-month program with placement support.

name: Job Placement Service — Tourism & Hospitality Sector
description: Professional job placement service connecting qualified candidates with hotels, restaurants, and tourism companies across Abu Dhabi. Resume preparation, interview coaching, and employer matching included.

name: Financial Literacy Workshop
description: Practical financial management workshop covering budgeting, debt management, savings strategies, and credit score improvement. Especially beneficial for families managing multiple financial obligations.

name: Administrative Support & Data Entry Training
description: Professional training in office administration, data entry, Microsoft Office suite, and business communication. Prepares candidates for administrative roles in government and private sectors.

name: Healthcare Assistant Certification Program
description: Training program for healthcare assistants and support staff. Covers patient care basics, medical terminology, hygiene protocols, and emergency response. Includes clinical placement.

name: Retail & Customer Service Excellence Program
description: Comprehensive customer service and retail management training. Covers sales techniques, inventory management, POS systems, and customer relationship management.

name: Construction & Technical Skills Training
description: Vocational training in construction trades including carpentry, electrical work, plumbing, and HVAC. Safety certification included. High demand in Abu Dhabi construction sector.

name: Digital Skills & IT Support Fundamentals
description: Entry-level IT training covering computer basics, troubleshooting, networking fundamentals, and help desk support. Gateway to technology sector careers.

name: Childcare & Early Education Training
description: Professional childcare training for individuals seeking careers in nurseries and early childhood education. Covers child development, safety, and educational activities.

name: Small Business & Entrepreneurship Support
description: Comprehensive support for aspiring entrepreneurs including business planning, financial management, licensing assistance, and mentorship. Microgrant opportunities available.

name: Career Counseling & Resume Building Service
description: One-on-one career counseling, skills assessment, resume preparation, and job search strategies. Helps applicants identify suitable career paths and improve employability.

name: Arabic Language & Professional Communication
description: Arabic language training for non-native speakers and professional communication skills development. Improves employment prospects in UAE job market.

name: Food Service & Culinary Skills Training
description: Professional culinary training for kitchen staff and food service workers. Covers food safety, cooking techniques, menu planning, and kitchen management.

name: Logistics & Supply Chain Fundamentals
description: Training in warehouse operations, inventory management, logistics coordination, and supply chain basics. Prepares for roles in growing logistics sector.

name: Driver & Transportation Service Training
description: Professional driver training including defensive driving, customer service, vehicle maintenance basics, and licensing support. High demand for qualified drivers.

name: Security & Facility Management Training
description: Professional security guard and facility management training. Covers security protocols, emergency response, access control, and customer interaction.

name: Elderly Care & Home Support Services
description: Training for home care assistants and elderly support workers. Covers personal care, medication assistance, mobility support, and companionship.

name: Job Placement — General Employment Service
description: Broad job placement service connecting candidates with opportunities across all sectors. Regular job fairs, employer partnerships, and ongoing placement support.

name: Debt Management & Financial Rehabilitation
description: Specialized support for individuals with significant debt. Includes financial counseling, debt restructuring assistance, and budget planning to achieve financial stability.

name: Women's Economic Empowerment Program
description: Comprehensive support for women seeking economic independence. Combines skills training, career counseling, childcare support, and flexible work opportunities.
